page_title: MON 0-1 WOL | B. Monchengladbach v Wolfsburg 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' It is time for a substitution. Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is on for Mohamed Amoura.
90+1' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is able to continue to play.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

85' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he slams his shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rocco Reitz will be replaced by Shio Fukuda (B. Monchengladbach).
82' The game has come to an end for Franck Honorat. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).

82' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
81' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will deliver the corner kick.
79' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
79' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Jonas Omlin easily deals with the threat. Wolfsburg have a corner.
78' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
75' Here comes a substitution. Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Lukas Nmecha.
75' Daniel Bauer has decided to make a change. Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) replaces Lovro Majer.
74' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
72' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and Sascha Stegemann immediately signals a free kick.
69' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Robin Hack walks off the pitch to be replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
67' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Stefan Lainer will be replaced by Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach).
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is replacing Philipp Sander.
66' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
65' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
64' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) replaces Patrick Wimmer.
58' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) launches a cross from the corner, but Kamil Grabara is alert to thwart the effort.
58' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
58' An attempted cross from Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.
55' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
53' A lofted cross from Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

50' 0 - 1 Mohamed Amoura sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:1.
50' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
48' The corner kick from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
48' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Now Wolfsburg have a corner.
47' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
46' B. Monchengladbach quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
46' A pass into the penalty area from Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is intercepted by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and B. Monchengladbach will take a corner.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
45+1' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45+1' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' One of the B. Monchengladbach players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
42' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Jonas Omlin was alert and made a comfortable save.
39' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

39' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Jonas Omlin has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
37' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
37' Jonas Omlin (B. Monchengladbach) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
35' Jonas Omlin comes off his line to intercept the corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg).
35' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes.
31' The game is interrupted now, Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends it out of play.
29' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.

29' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the left post. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
28' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
27' A goal, which was scored by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach), was disallowed due to offside.
25' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends the corner into the box, but Jonas Omlin intercepts it and averts the threat.
25' Flag up against Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

23' Wasted effort! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
22' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) tackles a bit over-zealously and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
21' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save.

20' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Jonas Omlin shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.

19' The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick. A precise low pass is received by Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from B. Monchengladbach.
14' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

14' What a wasted opportunity by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara makes an astonishing save to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for B. Monchengladbach.
13' Surely that's handball by one of the Wolfsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
11' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) brings an opponent down and Sascha Stegemann interrupts the game.

10' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.

8' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
6' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' Wolfsburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Sascha Stegemann.
